# fjordrun_agent (Data Source)

An agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "agent_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_agent" "support" {
  id = var.agent_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `id` (String) Agent ID.

- `model` (String) Model ID.

- `temperature` (Number) Temperature.
